notes.title: 0.45 Demo patch notes
notes.content: [p]0.45 Demo patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Added anti-aliasing settings to graphics sub-menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where mouse cursor was appearing on the wrong window after leaving pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]If graphics settings are not applied when leaving the graphics sub-menu they are reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled window resizing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where window size was not appearing on selected resolutions when game was running in a window.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added anti-aliasing settings to graphics sub-menu.

tags.bug: Fixed bug where mouse cursor was appearing on the wrong window after leaving pause menu.
Fixed bug where window size was not appearing on selected resolutions when game was running in a window.

notes.title: 0.44 Demo patch notes
notes.content:
0.44 Demo patch notes:

[list]
[*]     Removed hidden press M to show mouse cursor feature.
[*]     Mouse cursor appears when you move mouse and hides when player moves.
[*]     Bug fix: When you're holding the undo button, it stops undoing when you undo a reset. 
[*]     If player presses space before movement has finished, puzzle in/out transition will occur if on a transition tile.
[*]     Update play testers list in demo credits.
[/list]

tags.feature: Removed hidden press M to show mouse cursor feature.
Mouse cursor appears when you move mouse and hides when player moves.

tags.bug: Bug fix: When you're holding the undo button, it stops undoing when you undo a reset.
If player presses space before movement has finished, puzzle in/out transition will occur if on a transition tile.

tags.feature: Update play testers list in demo credits.
